prompt: The attached image is one of our approved ground tiles: match its palette, values and painterly low-detail style. Create ONE square 1:1 sprite atlas of 16 GROUND DECALS seen strictly from straight above (orthographic top-down, lying flat on the ground), arranged in an invisible 4 x 4 grid of equal cells, one decal centred in each cell, each filling about 70 percent of its cell. Row 1: three different clusters of fallen dry leaves (dull olive, brown and ochre-grey, 5-12 simple leaf shapes each) and one cluster of a few dark wet leaves. Row 2: two small broken twigs/branch bits, one tangle of thin dark roots, one scatter of tiny needles and leaf crumbs. Row 3: three different small groups of rounded grey-olive pebbles (3-8 stones each, soft painted shading inside the stones only), one single flat grey stone. Row 4: two soft irregular moss patches (dull moss green), one dark dry crack in the ground drawn as a thin branching line on a tiny bit of dark soil, one dark wet mud splash/stain blob. Background: perfectly flat pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere outside the objects (it is keyed out to transparency): no shadow, no gradient, no ground, no texture on the magenta, and no magenta or pink tones inside the objects. Every object fits fully inside its own cell with a clear magenta margin and never touches the cell border or another object. Style: hand-painted stylized game art matching the attached reference exactly (same brush style, low detail, large simple shapes, dark moody olive-green Diablo II forest palette, nothing saturated or bright), flat even lighting from above, no cast shadows on the background, no text, no labels, no grid lines drawn.
